response.sql: SELECT m.Name AS MediaTypeName, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS AvgUnitPrice, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS AvgBytesPerMillisecond FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name

assumptions.assumption: Division is done as real (non-integer) division, so Bytes/Milliseconds is not truncated; Milliseconds is assumed nonzero.
Grouping is per media type (MediaTypeId and Name), so media types sharing the same name would appear as separate rows; media types with no qualifying tracks are omitted.
